user_model_brief: Single-user Workbench feed; user Anshul (Meta eng). Prefers maximum-fidelity options; DB-authoritative config + hot-apply; shadcn/Tailwind-v4/React19 UI + hand-rolled SVG (no graph lib); per-package README enforced by tests/test_folder_docs.py; uses Claude Design tool for UI mockups. Plan deferred until after Claude Design mockups.

decisions.question: Execution model
decisions.answer: Real ordered stage executor; authored graph is execution order

decisions.question: Pipeline shape
decisions.answer: Routing DAG, single-path per-item execution

decisions.question: Concurrency
decisions.answer: Sequential now; node/edge model designed for later parallel fan-out

decisions.question: Re-divergence after convergence
decisions.answer: Supported via multiple outgoing edges

decisions.question: Rule expressiveness
decisions.answer: Nested boolean tree (AND/OR/NOT)

decisions.question: Field schema source
decisions.answer: Backend-declared per adapter, served to UI

decisions.question: Enricher config
decisions.answer: Full CRUD + depth + budget; DB-authoritative; hot-apply

decisions.question: Pre-extraction filtering point
decisions.answer: Inside enqueue, before urgency LLM scoring

decisions.question: Decision resolution
decisions.answer: First-terminal-wins + ordered 3-case threshold fallback

decisions.question: Storage authority
decisions.answer: DB-authoritative pipeline_nodes + pipeline_edges; behavior-preserving migration

decisions.question: Advisory vs deterministic rules
decisions.answer: Keep advisory FilterRules feeding llm_filter; add deterministic gates

decisions.question: Diagram technology
decisions.answer: Hand-rolled SVG, no graph library

decisions.question: Enrichment beyond triage branch
decisions.answer: Allowed on any post-extraction path; default migrated graph keeps triage-only

decisions.question: MAX_NODES_PER_ITEM
decisions.answer: 256; overflow → PipelineLoopError → fail-safe triage

decisions.question: Snapshot/reload concurrency
decisions.answer: Immutable PipelineGraph snapshot per walk; swap under reload_lock for new walks

decisions.question: funnel_stages.item_id type
decisions.answer: BIGINT = Item.id:int (migration 011); no type change

decisions.question: Loopback in v1
decisions.answer: Defined-but-rejected node type; rejected by validation; not seeded/offered/walked

decisions.question: Migration number + reserved IDs
decisions.answer: 018_pipeline_dag.py down_revision 017; reserved IDs IDENTITY-assigned, resolved by (type,role)

decisions.question: FieldSpec.segment=both enforcement
decisions.answer: Offered in either segment; validation accepts if declared segment includes node segment

decisions.question: Reserved node enabled
decisions.answer: Always enabled=true; validation rejects enabled=false on reserved nodes

decisions.question: Empty source_scope
decisions.answer: [] rejected; use enabled=false to disable

decisions.question: Edge-predicate segment
decisions.answer: from_node's segment; post-only field on pre-edge rejected

decisions.question: Invalid query params
decisions.answer: Unknown source_type / malformed segment / malformed window → 422
